status: UNAPPLIED optional Readable.toWeb byte bridge over unchanged m0.12 classic graph; host differential evidence only, no native or guest proof.
moduleContract: Finite root and promises namespaces. Root default is callable Stream; Stream.Stream is itself; shared constructors retain installed EventEmitter ancestry. Root.promises equals promises.default; pipeline/finished custom-promisify getters return matching promise bindings. Named ESM bindings snapshot installation values. Mutable default graphs do not synchronize named exports. Literal static CommonJS lowering returns default. No runtime public require/process or globals. Alternative manifest REPLACES m0.12 classic manifest, never duplicates its node:stream aliases. Existing classes/default/promises remain identical. Only Readable.toWeb is replaced; inherited deferred function diagnostics retain original m0.12 profile labels.

node:stream.callablePolicy: Candidate implementation of ordinary core constructors/lifecycle in the stated domain; deferred callable members throw own-coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED on call/new including top-level code.
node:stream.unsupportedPrototypePolicy: Readable compose/map/filter/forEach/toArray/some/find/every/flatMap/drop/take/reduce/iterator and Readable/Writable Symbol.asyncDispose are explicit throwing functions. asIndexedPairs is absent because not in Node22. Inherited copies of these deferred methods on Duplex remain deferred.
deviations: No native component gate yet; host reference scheduling is not the guest scheduler.

Byte inputs are ordinary attached fixed unshared ArrayBufferViews; raw byte windows preserve offset/backing, not element truncation. Shared/resizable/detached/proxy/exotic state domains are not claimed.
Default byte HWM is deterministically65536 and object HWM16. HWM remains a threshold, not a memory bound.

Queue budget units match Node state.length: bytes before decoding or UTF16 code units after decoding. Object/chunk counts do not bound arbitrary application payload or total memory. Discard a stream after its profile limit failure; full atomic rollback is not claimed.
Only existing bounded Buffer/StringDecoder encodings and errors apply; no Buffer pool, copy/concat/write/numeric API expansion.
Other Web overloads, function pipeline stages, pair/compose/operators/disposal/legacy module aliases remain deferred. This candidate does not register consumers or stream/web.

Registration getter/return-then-getter/Symbol.dispose identity and scheduler/reset/ALS/request teardown limitations remain independent. captureRejections:true remains explicitly unavailable through the installed Events foundation.
Public own-state mutation, arbitrary primordial mutation, full exact own-property reflection/error text/stack/cross-realm and async_hooks parity are not claimed.

Readable.toWeb supports fixed unshared non-detached Uint8Array/Buffer byte chunks, default or integer byte strategy.highWaterMark 0..1048576. Object mode, decoded strings, custom size, signal/options and exotic options records are explicitly refused. Source-level Readable AbortSignal and reader.cancel are supported; no new toWeb signal option.

Every chunk is snapshotted once at the visible byte window. Own data/end/error/close listeners are removed on retirement; a shared no-op late-error listener retains no controller/source. This deliberately differs from Node22 adapter data-listener retention after cancel.

Explicit consume/cancel is required. Abandoning an unread WebStream is not a proven cancellation/finalizer/Store-teardown event. The active16 lease cap bounds adapters, not arbitrary application payload/native resources. Cancel delegates synchronous destroy and does not wait for asynchronous _destroy completion, matching Node.

The actual existing native ReadableStream is required and must be initialized before node-compat. No host Node adapter, extra WASI import, bytes-mode/BYOB stream, Writable/Duplex conversion or Readable.fromWeb implementation is provided.

node:stream/promises.callablePolicy: Promise wrappers over the same bounded classic lifecycle. Native Web/function stages are explicitly deferred; no timers or host I/O.
deviations: No complete Node stream implementation or external I/O claimed.
